system.description: You bathe a creature that has been dead for no more than a year in the blood of a willing hero.

outcomes.triumph: It returns with half its HP, and no worse for the journey.
outcomes.success: It returns to life with 1 HP and a spark in its eyes. It is changed, but it is here.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the body does not stir, and the blood is spent.
outcomes.ruin: It returns, but something came back with it, and the Dark Master decides what. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
